page.layout: One printed page: running head centred at top with page number at upper left; title below running head; a framed emblem engraving in the centre; below it a four-line verse in italic, centred; catchword at lower right.

main_text.head: IVS IN MANIBVS.
main_text.p: [engraving: a lit candle on a tripod stand, a hand holding a balance with scales, a hand holding a sword, dice and playing cards on a table; no text]
main_text.l: Flos vt odorus api mel præbet, lurida fella
Ex quo sed contra toxica arachna bibit:
Haud secus ex diuo probus haurit iure salutem,
Per quod & iniustus iusta barathra subit.

page.notes: The title is set in italic capitals and the running head in spaced capitals; the verse is italic. The engraving is an emblem illustration described above, not printed text. The verse lines are reproduced as printed, including the spacing after "bibit". Catchword "Compe-" is at lower right.
